statements.status_notes: GHSA-2m67-wjpj-xhg9 affects tools.jackson.core/jackson-core 3.1.0 with no fixed version available. Jackson Core 3.0.2 fails to enforce StreamReadConstraints.maxDocumentLength across blocking, async, and DataInput parser code paths, allowing oversized JSON documents to bypass configured size limits. Fixed in 3.1.1. Waiting for upstream SonarQube to upgrade jackson-core. The vulnerable dependency is embedded in compiled application JARs and cannot be patched via JAR replacement.
